about_the_game:
Welcome to PixelBurg!

The age of oppression is over – reclaim your legacy!

Your family’s kingdom was taken from you, but now the hour of revenge has come. Build your power, lead your army, and construct a castle worthy of your ancestors' glory!

Castle Building – From Village to Fortress

Gather resources, expand your humble farmhouse into a thriving city, and construct over 20 different buildings. Assign professions to your subjects, collect taxes, and watch your castle flourish. Every wall, every tower brings you closer to your ultimate goal: dominion over the land!

Battles & Defense – War for the Crown

Your enemies do not rest – defend your realm against those who once overthrew your father. Or take the fight to them: storm their castles, conquer their lands, and expand your empire. Assemble a mighty army, organize your troops, and command them in epic battles!

Exploration – The World Awaits

Leave the safety of your walls and discover a world full of dangers and mysteries. Plunder ancient treasures, defeat bandits, and uncover valuable artifacts. But beware: not everything lurking in the wilderness can be conquered by steel…

Are you ready to reclaim your kingdom?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft 64bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium(R) CPU N3710 1.60 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Onboard Graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft 64bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium(R) CPU N3710 1.60 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Onboard Graphics or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Build your own castle, raise a powerful army, and reclaim the kingdom! Gather resources, defend your realm against enemies, and explore a dangerous world full of treasures and secrets. Will you rise as a ruler or fade into the shadows of history?
